SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

5. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   B. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   D. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

8. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

11. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

4. A — Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
